"""Run with python3 -B <this-file>; uses only temporary projects."""
import json
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

SCRIPT = Path(__file__).with_name('ensure_entrypoint_links.py')


class EntryPointLinksTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temporary.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temporary.name)
        for package in ('common', 'project'):
            directory = self.root / 'harness' / package
            directory.mkdir(parents=True)
            (directory / 'INDEX.md').write_text('# Index\n')
            (directory / 'START.md').touch()
        template = SCRIPT.parent.parent / 'base/project-skeleton.json'
        if template.exists():
            destination = self.root / 'harness/common/base/project-skeleton.json'
            destination.parent.mkdir()
            shutil.copyfile(template, destination)

    def run_check(self):
        return subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', str(SCRIPT), str(self.root)],
                              text=True, capture_output=True)

    def test_creates_four_links_and_import_then_preserves_bytes(self):
        result = self.run_check()
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        agents = self.root / 'AGENTS.md'
        claude = self.root / 'CLAUDE.md'
        for package in ('common', 'project'):
            for name in ('INDEX.md', 'START.md'):
                self.assertIn(f'](harness/{package}/{name})', agents.read_text())
        self.assertEqual(claude.read_bytes(), b'@AGENTS.md\n')
        before = (agents.read_bytes(), claude.read_bytes())
        self.assertEqual(self.run_check().returncode, 0)
        self.assertEqual(before, (agents.read_bytes(), claude.read_bytes()))
        for file in self.root.glob('harness/*/START.md'):
            self.assertEqual(file.read_bytes(), b'')

    def test_only_appends_missing_links_preserving_user_text(self):
        prefix = '# User configuration\n\nKeep this exact text.\n[Existing](./harness/common/INDEX.md)\n'
        (self.root / 'AGENTS.md').write_text(prefix)
        self.assertEqual(self.run_check().returncode, 0)
        text = (self.root / 'AGENTS.md').read_text()
        self.assertTrue(text.startswith(prefix))
        self.assertEqual(text.count('harness/common/INDEX.md'), 1)

    def test_link_examples_in_code_do_not_count_as_real_links(self):
        examples = '\n'.join(f'[Example](harness/{p}/{n})'
                             for p in ('common', 'project') for n in ('INDEX.md', 'START.md'))
        (self.root / 'AGENTS.md').write_text(f'```md\n{examples}\n```\n')
        self.assertEqual(self.run_check().returncode, 0)
        text = (self.root / 'AGENTS.md').read_text()
        self.assertEqual(text.count('](harness/common/INDEX.md)'), 2)

    def test_repair_preserves_original_bytes_and_each_files_line_endings(self):
        agents, claude = self.root / 'AGENTS.md', self.root / 'CLAUDE.md'
        for newline in (b'\n', b'\r\n'):
            with self.subTest(newline=newline):
                original = newline.join((b'# User settings', b'Keep exact bytes.', b'', b''))
                bridge = b'User bridge text\r\n'
                agents.write_bytes(original)
                claude.write_bytes(bridge)
                result = self.run_check()
                self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
                repaired = agents.read_bytes()
                self.assertTrue(repaired.startswith(original))
                self.assertIn(b'](harness/common/START.md)' + newline, repaired)
                if newline == b'\r\n':
                    self.assertNotIn(b'\n', repaired.replace(b'\r\n', b''))
                self.assertEqual(claude.read_bytes(), b'@AGENTS.md\r\n' + bridge)
                before = agents.read_bytes(), claude.read_bytes()
                second = self.run_check()
                self.assertEqual(second.returncode, 0, second.stderr)
                self.assertNotIn('будут автоматически восстановлены', second.stdout)
                self.assertEqual((agents.read_bytes(), claude.read_bytes()), before)

    def test_valid_crlf_bridge_is_preserved_without_warning_or_repair(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.run_check().returncode, 0)
        agents, claude = self.root / 'AGENTS.md', self.root / 'CLAUDE.md'
        agents.write_bytes(agents.read_bytes().replace(b'\n', b'\r\n'))
        claude.write_bytes(b'@AGENTS.md\r\n')
        before = agents.read_bytes(), claude.read_bytes()
        result = self.run_check()
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        self.assertNotIn('будут автоматически восстановлены', result.stdout)
        self.assertNotIn('требуется единственная строка', result.stdout)
        self.assertEqual((agents.read_bytes(), claude.read_bytes()), before)

    def test_longer_fence_closers_do_not_turn_examples_into_installed_links(self):
        examples = '\n'.join(f'[Example](harness/{p}/{n})'
                             for p in ('common', 'project') for n in ('INDEX.md', 'START.md'))
        examples += ('\n[Rules](.claude/rules/)\n'
                     'До выполнения задачи прочитай все Markdown-правила из .claude/rules '
                     'и его подпапок, кроме README.human.md; соблюдай применимые требования.')
        agents = self.root / 'AGENTS.md'
        for opener, closer in (('~~~md', '~~~~'), ('```md', '````')):
            with self.subTest(opener=opener):
                prefix = f'# Keep user settings\n{opener}\n{examples}\n{closer}\n'
                agents.write_text(prefix)
                first = self.run_check()
                self.assertEqual(first.returncode, 0, first.stderr)
                text = agents.read_text()
                self.assertTrue(text.startswith(prefix))
                appended = text[len(prefix):]
                for package in ('common', 'project'):
                    for name in ('INDEX.md', 'START.md'):
                        self.assertIn(f'](harness/{package}/{name})', appended)
                self.assertIn('](.claude/rules/)', appended)
                self.assertIn('прочитай все Markdown-правила', appended)
                before = agents.read_bytes()
                second = self.run_check()
                self.assertEqual(second.returncode, 0, second.stderr)
                self.assertEqual(agents.read_bytes(), before)

    def test_unclosed_fence_fails_before_writing_either_entrypoint(self):
        agents, claude = self.root / 'AGENTS.md', self.root / 'CLAUDE.md'
        for name in ('AGENTS.md', 'CLAUDE.md'):
            for opener in ('~~~md', '```md'):
                with self.subTest(name=name, opener=opener):
                    agents.write_text('# Keep user settings\n')
                    claude.write_text('Keep bridge text\n')
                    (self.root / name).write_text(f'# Keep user settings\n{opener}\nexample\n')
                    before = agents.read_bytes(), claude.read_bytes()
                    result = self.run_check()
                    self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 2, result.stderr)
                    self.assertIn('Unclosed Markdown code fence', result.stderr)
                    self.assertEqual((agents.read_bytes(), claude.read_bytes()), before)
                    self.assertFalse((self.root / '.claude').exists())

    def test_damaged_package_is_reported_without_creating_dangling_links(self):
        (self.root / 'harness/project/START.md').unlink()
        result = self.run_check()
        self.assertNotEqual(result.returncode, 0)
        self.assertFalse((self.root / 'AGENTS.md').exists())
        self.assertFalse((self.root / 'CLAUDE.md').exists())

    def test_common_only_creates_neutral_project(self):
        shutil.rmtree(self.root / 'harness/project')
        result = self.run_check()
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        project = self.root / 'harness/project'
        expected = {'base', 'decisions', 'lessons', 'testing', 'rules', 'skills',
                    'checks', 'inbox', 'docs', 'handoffs'}
        self.assertTrue(project.is_dir(), 'common-only must create project')
        self.assertEqual({p.name for p in project.iterdir() if p.is_dir()}, expected)
        for directory in [project, *(project / name for name in expected)]:
            self.assertTrue((directory / 'README.human.md').is_file())
        self.assertFalse((project / 'checks/ensure_entrypoint_links.py').exists())
        self.assertNotIn('EPL', (project / 'INDEX.md').read_text())
        self.assertIn('harness/common/checks/ensure_entrypoint_links.py',
                      (project / 'START.md').read_text())
        self.assertIn('harness/project/START.md', (self.root / 'AGENTS.md').read_text())
        before = {p.relative_to(project): p.stat().st_mtime_ns for p in project.rglob('*')}
        self.assertEqual(self.run_check().returncode, 0)
        self.assertEqual(before, {p.relative_to(project): p.stat().st_mtime_ns for p in project.rglob('*')})

    def test_existing_project_is_not_regenerated_or_exported(self):
        project = self.root / 'harness/project'
        task = project / 'docs/epl-import/notes.md'
        task.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
        task.write_bytes(b'project-specific material\n')
        before = {p.relative_to(project): p.read_bytes() for p in project.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
        self.assertEqual(self.run_check().returncode, 0)
        self.assertEqual(before, {p.relative_to(project): p.read_bytes() for p in project.rglob('*') if p.is_file()})
        self.assertFalse((project / 'base').exists(), 'existing project is not filled with a new skeleton')

    def test_new_template_categories_apply_only_to_new_project(self):
        template = self.root / 'harness/common/base/project-skeleton.json'
        data = json.loads(template.read_text())
        data['categories']['specs'] = {'purpose': 'Shared specifications', 'example': 'api.md describes an agreed API.'}
        template.write_text(json.dumps(data))
        self.assertEqual(self.run_check().returncode, 0)
        self.assertFalse((self.root / 'harness/project/specs').exists())
        shutil.rmtree(self.root / 'harness/project')
        result = self.run_check()
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        self.assertTrue((self.root / 'harness/project/specs/README.human.md').is_file())

    def test_project_only_is_rejected_before_writes(self):
        shutil.rmtree(self.root / 'harness/common')
        result = self.run_check()
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 2)
        self.assertIn('common', result.stderr)
        self.assertFalse((self.root / 'AGENTS.md').exists())
        self.assertFalse((self.root / '.claude').exists())

    def test_unsafe_project_path_is_rejected_without_writes(self):
        project = self.root / 'harness/project'
        shutil.rmtree(project)
        for symlink in (False, True):
            with self.subTest(symlink=symlink):
                if symlink:
                    project.symlink_to(self.root / 'missing-project')
                else:
                    project.write_text('keep this file')
                result = self.run_check()
                self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 2)
                self.assertFalse((self.root / 'AGENTS.md').exists())
                self.assertFalse((self.root / '.claude').exists())
                project.unlink()

    def test_invalid_template_does_not_create_project(self):
        project = self.root / 'harness/project'
        shutil.rmtree(project)
        template = self.root / 'harness/common/base/project-skeleton.json'
        for content in ('not json', '{}', '{"categories": {"../outside": {"purpose": "bad", "example": "bad"}}}'):
            with self.subTest(content=content):
                template.write_text(content)
                result = self.run_check()
                self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 2)
                self.assertFalse(project.exists())
                self.assertFalse((self.root / 'AGENTS.md').exists())

    def test_invalid_entrypoint_prevents_project_creation(self):
        shutil.rmtree(self.root / 'harness/project')
        agents = self.root / 'AGENTS.md'
        agents.write_text('# Keep\n```md\nunterminated')
        result = self.run_check()
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 2)
        self.assertFalse((self.root / 'harness/project').exists())
        self.assertEqual(agents.read_text(), '# Keep\n```md\nunterminated')

    def test_adds_import_and_warns_about_extra_claude_content_without_deleting_it(self):
        (self.root / 'CLAUDE.md').write_text('User text\n')
        result = self.run_check()
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0)
        self.assertIn('inbox', result.stdout)
        self.assertIn('технически не заблокировано', result.stdout)
        self.assertEqual((self.root / 'CLAUDE.md').read_text(), '@AGENTS.md\nUser text\n')

    def test_refuses_symlinked_entrypoint_without_changing_target(self):
        target = self.root / 'user.md'
        target.write_text('User text\n')
        (self.root / 'AGENTS.md').symlink_to(target)
        self.assertNotEqual(self.run_check().returncode, 0)
        self.assertEqual(target.read_text(), 'User text\n')

    def test_rules_link_is_restored_and_directory_created(self):
        (self.root / 'AGENTS.md').write_text('# User settings\n\n```md\n[Rules](.claude/rules/)\n```\n')
        first = self.run_check()
        self.assertEqual(first.returncode, 0, first.stderr)
        agents = self.root / 'AGENTS.md'
        self.assertEqual(agents.read_text().count('](.claude/rules/)'), 2)
        self.assertIn('README.human.md', agents.read_text())
        self.assertTrue((self.root / '.claude/rules').is_dir())
        before = agents.read_bytes()
        self.assertEqual(self.run_check().returncode, 0)
        self.assertEqual(agents.read_bytes(), before)

    def test_existing_relative_rules_links_are_not_duplicated(self):
        for target in ('.claude/rules', '.claude/rules/', './.claude/rules/', '<./.claude/rules/>'):
            with self.subTest(target=target):
                (self.root / 'AGENTS.md').write_text(f'# User settings\n[Rules]({target})\n')
                self.assertEqual(self.run_check().returncode, 0)
                text = (self.root / 'AGENTS.md').read_text()
                self.assertEqual(text.count('[Rules]'), 1)
                self.assertNotIn('- [.claude/rules]', text)
                self.assertIn('прочитай все Markdown-правила', text)

    def test_unsafe_rules_directory_does_not_change_entrypoints(self):
        (self.root / 'AGENTS.md').write_text('# Keep\n')
        for relative in ('.claude', '.claude/rules'):
            for symlink in (False, True):
                with self.subTest(relative=relative, symlink=symlink):
                    path = self.root / relative
                    path.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
                    if symlink:
                        path.symlink_to(self.root / 'harness', target_is_directory=True)
                    else:
                        path.write_text('keep\n')
                    try:
                        result = self.run_check()
                        self.assertNotEqual(result.returncode, 0)
                        self.assertEqual((self.root / 'AGENTS.md').read_text(), '# Keep\n')
                        self.assertFalse((self.root / 'CLAUDE.md').exists())
                    finally:
                        path.unlink()


if __name__ == '__main__':

"""Run the installed analyzer through the launcher; never print human bodies."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest


LAUNCHER = Path(__file__).with_name('plugin_eval_without_human.mjs')


class HumanFilterTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_installed_analyzer_and_read_guards(self):
        executable = shutil.which('plugin-eval')
        self.assertIsNotNone(executable, 'Install plugin-eval before this integration check')
        cli = Path(executable).resolve()
        plugin_files = [cli, *cli.parent.parent.joinpath('src').rglob('*.js')]
        digest = lambda files: {str(p): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in files}
        plugin_before = digest(plugin_files)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
            root = Path(temp)
            for kind in ('skill', 'rule', 'plugin'):
                target = root / kind
                target.mkdir()
                (target / 'details.md').write_text('Machine guidance.\n')
                if kind == 'skill':
                    (target / 'SKILL.md').write_text('---\nname: skill\ndescription: Use when testing a skill.\n---\nRead details.md.\n')
                elif kind == 'rule':
                    (target / 'comm-example.md').write_text('When testing, preserve the input.\n')
                else:
                    manifest = target / '.codex-plugin'
                    manifest.mkdir()
                    (manifest / 'plugin.json').write_text(json.dumps({'name': 'example', 'version': '1.0.0', 'description': 'Example plugin'}))
                nested = target / 'nested'
                nested.mkdir()
                for folder in (target, nested):
                    (folder / 'README.human.md').write_text('HUMAN_CANARY_DO_NOT_READ\n' * 400)
                before = digest(p for p in target.rglob('*') if p.is_file())
                result = subprocess.run(['node', str(LAUNCHER), str(cli), 'analyze', str(target), '--format', 'json'], capture_output=True, text=True)
                self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
                report = json.loads(result.stdout)
                self.assertEqual(report['target']['kind'], 'directory' if kind == 'rule' else kind)
                components = report['budgets']['deferred_cost_tokens']['components']
                self.assertTrue(any(c['path'].endswith('details.md') for c in components))
                self.assertFalse(any(c['path'].endswith('README.human.md') for c in components))
                self.assertNotIn('HUMAN_CANARY', result.stdout)
                self.assertEqual(before, digest(p for p in target.rglob('*') if p.is_file()))
            # A direct read must fail before the body reaches stdout, including an alias.
            human = root / 'skill' / 'README.human.md'
            alias = root / 'alias.md'
            alias.symlink_to(human)
            probe = root / 'probe.mjs'
            for source in (human, alias):
                probe.write_text("import fs from 'node:fs/promises';\nconsole.log(await fs.readFile(" + json.dumps(str(source)) + ", 'utf8'));\n")
                result = subprocess.run(['node', str(LAUNCHER), str(probe)], capture_output=True, text=True)
                self.assertNotEqual(result.returncode, 0)
                self.assertIn('README.human.md', result.stderr)
                self.assertNotIn('HUMAN_CANARY', result.stdout + result.stderr)
            protected = root / 'protected.txt'
            protected.write_text('unchanged')
            probe.write_text("import fs from 'node:fs/promises';\nawait fs.writeFile(" + json.dumps(str(protected)) + ", 'changed');\n")
            result = subprocess.run(['node', str(LAUNCHER), str(probe)], capture_output=True, text=True)
            self.assertNotEqual(result.returncode, 0)
            self.assertEqual(protected.read_text(), 'unchanged')
        self.assertEqual(plugin_before, digest(plugin_files))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()

"""Exercise two supported installations and reject missing common."""
import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

PACKAGES = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
MODES = [('common',), ('common', 'project')]


class PortabilityTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def install(self, root, mode):
        shutil.copytree(PACKAGES / 'common', root / 'harness/common',
                        ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns('inbox', '__pycache__'))
        if 'project' in mode:
            project = root / 'harness/project'
            if (PACKAGES / 'project').is_dir():
                shutil.copytree(PACKAGES / 'project', project)
            else:
                project.mkdir()
                (project / 'INDEX.md').write_text('# Existing project\n')
                (project / 'START.md').write_text('# Existing startup\n')
            material = project / 'docs/local-task/notes.md'
            material.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            material.write_bytes(b'Existing project material\n')

    def run_check(self, root, script='harness/common/checks/ensure_entrypoint_links.py'):
        return subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', script], cwd=root,
                              env=dict(os.environ, PATH='/no-git-in-this-test'),
                              capture_output=True, text=True)

    def test_startup_command_runs_in_each_clean_mode_without_git(self):
        for mode in MODES:
            with self.subTest(mode=mode), tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
                root = Path(directory)
                self.install(root, mode)
                project = root / 'harness/project'
                before = {p.relative_to(project): p.read_bytes() for p in project.rglob('*')
                          if p.is_file() and p.name != 'README.human.md'}
                first = self.run_check(root)
                self.assertEqual(first.returncode, 0, first.stderr)
                if 'project' in mode:
                    self.assertEqual(before, {p.relative_to(project): p.read_bytes()
                                     for p in project.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and p.name != 'README.human.md'})
                else:
                    self.assertTrue((project / 'base/README.human.md').is_file())
                    self.assertFalse((project / 'docs/local-task').exists())
                text = (root / 'AGENTS.md').read_text()
                self.assertIn('](.claude/rules/)', text)
                self.assertIn('harness/project/START.md', text)
                command = re.search(r'(?m)^python3(?: -B)? (harness/[^\s]+\.py)$', text)
                self.assertIsNotNone(command)
                self.assertEqual(command.group(1), 'harness/common/checks/ensure_entrypoint_links.py')
                before_inputs = (root / 'AGENTS.md').read_bytes(), (root / 'CLAUDE.md').read_bytes()
                second = self.run_check(root, command.group(1))
                self.assertEqual(second.returncode, 0, second.stderr)
                self.assertNotIn('будут автоматически восстановлены', second.stdout)
                self.assertEqual(before_inputs, ((root / 'AGENTS.md').read_bytes(), (root / 'CLAUDE.md').read_bytes()))
                self.assertFalse((root / '.git').exists())

    def test_existing_settings_and_startup_command_are_never_rewritten(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            self.install(root, ('common', 'project'))
            legacy = root / 'harness/project/checks/ensure_entrypoint_links.py'
            script = legacy.relative_to(root).as_posix() if legacy.exists() else 'harness/common/checks/ensure_entrypoint_links.py'
            prefix = '# Existing settings\n\npython3 ' + script + '\nKeep this setting.\n'
            (root / 'AGENTS.md').write_text(prefix)
            result = self.run_check(root, script)
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
            self.assertTrue((root / 'AGENTS.md').read_text().startswith(prefix))

    def test_legacy_checker_rejects_symlinked_common_ancestors(self):
        for relative in ('harness/common', 'harness/common/checks'):
            with self.subTest(relative=relative), tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
                root = Path(directory)
                self.install(root, ('common', 'project'))
                legacy = root / 'harness/project/checks/ensure_entrypoint_links.py'
                if not legacy.exists():
                    self.skipTest('No legacy shim in a common-only source installation.')
                external = root / 'external'
                checker = external / ('checks/ensure_entrypoint_links.py'
                                      if relative == 'harness/common' else 'ensure_entrypoint_links.py')
                checker.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
                marker = root / 'external-code-executed'
                checker.write_text('from pathlib import Path\nPath(' + repr(str(marker)) + ').touch()\n')
                directory_path = root / relative
                directory_path.rename(directory_path.with_name(directory_path.name + '-original'))
                directory_path.symlink_to(external, target_is_directory=True)
                result = self.run_check(root, str(legacy))
                self.assertFalse(marker.exists(), 'shim must reject symlinked ancestors before execution')
                self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 2, result.stderr)
                self.assertFalse((root / 'AGENTS.md').exists())

    def test_required_resource_damage_is_detected(self):
        for mode in MODES:
            with self.subTest(mode=mode), tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
                root = Path(directory)
                self.install(root, mode)
                (root / 'harness/common/START.md').unlink()

"""Check installed shared rules and exercise copy-drift failures."""
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]


def check_rule_copies(root):
    if not (root / 'harness/common').is_dir():
        raise ValueError('harness/common is required; project-only is unsupported.')
    native = root / '.claude/rules'
    sources = {}
    installed_prefixes = []
    for package, prefix in (('common', 'comm-'), ('project', 'proj-')):
        rules = root / 'harness' / package / 'rules'
        if rules.is_dir():
            installed_prefixes.append(prefix)
            sources.update((file.name, file) for file in rules.glob(prefix + '*.md'))
    if not sources:
        raise ValueError('No canonical shared rules found; nothing checked.')
    expected = set(sources)
    actual = {file.name for prefix in installed_prefixes
              for file in native.glob(prefix + '*.md')}
    if expected != actual:
        raise ValueError(f'Missing copies: {sorted(expected - actual)}; '
                         f'extra copies: {sorted(actual - expected)}')
    for name, source in sorted(sources.items()):
        copy = native / name
        for file in (source, copy):
            if not file.is_file() or any(path.is_symlink() for path in (file, *file.parents)):
                raise ValueError(f'Not an ordinary file: {file}')
        if source.read_bytes() != copy.read_bytes():
            raise ValueError(f'Different rule bytes: {name}')
    return len(sources)


class RuleCopiesTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_installed_rule_copies(self):
        count = check_rule_copies(ROOT)
        print(f'Checked {count} shared rule copies.')

    def test_project_only_rules_are_rejected(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            source = root / 'harness/project/rules'
            native = root / '.claude/rules'
            source.mkdir(parents=True)
            native.mkdir(parents=True)
            for folder in (source, native):
                (folder / 'proj-example.md').write_bytes(b'canonical\n')
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'common'):
                check_rule_copies(root)

    def test_copy_drift_is_detected(self):
        for mode in (('common',), ('common', 'project')):
            with self.subTest(mode=mode), tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
                root = Path(directory)
                native = root / '.claude/rules'
                native.mkdir(parents=True)
                for package in mode:
                    rules = root / 'harness' / package / 'rules'
                    rules.mkdir(parents=True)
                    prefix = 'comm-' if package == 'common' else 'proj-'
                    (rules / (prefix + 'example.md')).write_bytes(b'canonical\n')
                    (rules / 'README.human.md').write_bytes(b'')
                    (native / (prefix + 'example.md')).write_bytes(b'canonical\n')
                (native / 'personal.md').write_bytes(b'personal\n')
                self.assertEqual(check_rule_copies(root), len(mode))
                source = next((root / 'harness' / mode[0] / 'rules').glob('*-example.md'))
                copy = native / source.name
                copy.unlink()
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'Missing copies'):
                    check_rule_copies(root)
                copy.write_bytes(b'changed\n')
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'Different rule bytes'):
                    check_rule_copies(root)
                copy.unlink()
                copy.symlink_to(source)
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'Not an ordinary file'):
                    check_rule_copies(root)
                copy.unlink()
                copy.write_bytes(source.read_bytes())
                extra = native / (source.name.split('-')[0] + '-stale.md')
                extra.write_bytes(b'stale\n')
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'extra copies'):
                    check_rule_copies(root)
                extra.unlink()
                self.assertEqual(check_rule_copies(root), len(mode))
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'common'):
                check_rule_copies(Path(directory))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()

"""Run the installed analyzer through the launcher; never print human bodies."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest


LAUNCHER = Path(__file__).with_name('plugin_eval_without_human.mjs')


class HumanFilterTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_installed_analyzer_and_read_guards(self):
        executable = shutil.which('plugin-eval')
        self.assertIsNotNone(executable, 'Install plugin-eval before this integration check')
        cli = Path(executable).resolve()
        plugin_files = [cli, *cli.parent.parent.joinpath('src').rglob('*.js')]
        digest = lambda files: {str(p): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in files}
        plugin_before = digest(plugin_files)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
            root = Path(temp)
            for kind in ('skill', 'rule', 'plugin'):
                target = root / kind
                target.mkdir()
                (target / 'details.md').write_text('Machine guidance.\n')
                if kind == 'skill':
                    (target / 'SKILL.md').write_text('---\nname: skill\ndescription: Use when testing a skill.\n---\nRead details.md.\n')
                elif kind == 'rule':
                    (target / 'comm-example.md').write_text('When testing, preserve the input.\n')
                else:
                    manifest = target / '.codex-plugin'
                    manifest.mkdir()
                    (manifest / 'plugin.json').write_text(json.dumps({'name': 'example', 'version': '1.0.0', 'description': 'Example plugin'}))
                nested = target / 'nested'
                nested.mkdir()
                for folder in (target, nested):
                    (folder / 'README.human.md').write_text('HUMAN_CANARY_DO_NOT_READ\n' * 400)
                before = digest(p for p in target.rglob('*') if p.is_file())
                result = subprocess.run(['node', str(LAUNCHER), str(cli), 'analyze', str(target), '--format', 'json'], capture_output=True, text=True)
                self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
                report = json.loads(result.stdout)
                self.assertEqual(report['target']['kind'], 'directory' if kind == 'rule' else kind)
                components = report['budgets']['deferred_cost_tokens']['components']
                self.assertTrue(any(c['path'].endswith('details.md') for c in components))
                self.assertFalse(any(c['path'].endswith('README.human.md') for c in components))
                self.assertNotIn('HUMAN_CANARY', result.stdout)
                self.assertEqual(before, digest(p for p in target.rglob('*') if p.is_file()))
            # A direct read must fail before the body reaches stdout, including an alias.
            human = root / 'skill' / 'README.human.md'
            alias = root / 'alias.md'
            alias.symlink_to(human)
            probe = root / 'probe.mjs'
            for source in (human, alias):
                probe.write_text("import fs from 'node:fs/promises';\nconsole.log(await fs.readFile(" + json.dumps(str(source)) + ", 'utf8'));\n")
                result = subprocess.run(['node', str(LAUNCHER), str(probe)], capture_output=True, text=True)
                self.assertNotEqual(result.returncode, 0)
                self.assertIn('README.human.md', result.stderr)
                self.assertNotIn('HUMAN_CANARY', result.stdout + result.stderr)
            protected = root / 'protected.txt'
            protected.write_text('unchanged')
            probe.write_text("import fs from 'node:fs/promises';\nawait fs.writeFile(" + json.dumps(str(protected)) + ", 'changed');\n")
            result = subprocess.run(['node', str(LAUNCHER), str(probe)], capture_output=True, text=True)
            self.assertNotEqual(result.returncode, 0)
            self.assertEqual(protected.read_text(), 'unchanged')
        self.assertEqual(plugin_before, digest(plugin_files))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()

import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

PACKAGES = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
MODES = [('common',), ('common', 'project')]


class PortabilityTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def install(self, root, mode):
        shutil.copytree(PACKAGES / 'common', root / 'harness/common',
                        ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns('inbox', '__pycache__'))
        if 'project' in mode:
            project = root / 'harness/project'
            if (PACKAGES / 'project').is_dir():
                shutil.copytree(PACKAGES / 'project', project)
            else:
                project.mkdir()
                (project / 'INDEX.md').write_text('# Existing project\n')
                (project / 'START.md').write_text('# Existing startup\n')
            material = project / 'docs/local-task/notes.md'
            material.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            material.write_bytes(b'Existing project material\n')

    def run_check(self, root, script='harness/common/checks/ensure_entrypoint_links.py'):
        return subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', script], cwd=root,
                              env=dict(os.environ, PATH='/no-git-in-this-test'),
                              capture_output=True, text=True)

    def test_startup_command_runs_in_each_clean_mode_without_git(self):
        for mode in MODES:
            with self.subTest(mode=mode), tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
                root = Path(directory)
                self.install(root, mode)
                project = root / 'harness/project'
                before = {p.relative_to(project): p.read_bytes() for p in project.rglob('*')
                          if p.is_file() and p.name != 'README.human.md'}
                first = self.run_check(root)
                self.assertEqual(first.returncode, 0, first.stderr)
                if 'project' in mode:
                    self.assertEqual(before, {p.relative_to(project): p.read_bytes()
                                     for p in project.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and p.name != 'README.human.md'})
                else:
                    self.assertTrue((project / 'base/README.human.md').is_file())
                    self.assertFalse((project / 'docs/local-task').exists())
                text = (root / 'AGENTS.md').read_text()
                self.assertIn('](.claude/rules/)', text)
                self.assertIn('harness/project/START.md', text)
                command = re.search(r'(?m)^python3(?: -B)? (harness/[^\s]+\.py)$', text)
                self.assertIsNotNone(command)
                self.assertEqual(command.group(1), 'harness/common/checks/ensure_entrypoint_links.py')
                before_inputs = (root / 'AGENTS.md').read_bytes(), (root / 'CLAUDE.md').read_bytes()
                second = self.run_check(root, command.group(1))
                self.assertEqual(second.returncode, 0, second.stderr)
                self.assertNotIn('будут автоматически восстановлены', second.stdout)
                self.assertEqual(before_inputs, ((root / 'AGENTS.md').read_bytes(), (root / 'CLAUDE.md').read_bytes()))
                self.assertFalse((root / '.git').exists())

    def test_existing_settings_and_startup_command_are_never_rewritten(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            self.install(root, ('common', 'project'))
            legacy = root / 'harness/project/checks/ensure_entrypoint_links.py'
            script = legacy.relative_to(root).as_posix() if legacy.exists() else 'harness/common/checks/ensure_entrypoint_links.py'
            prefix = '# Existing settings\n\npython3 ' + script + '\nKeep this setting.\n'
            (root / 'AGENTS.md').write_text(prefix)
            result = self.run_check(root, script)
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
            self.assertTrue((root / 'AGENTS.md').read_text().startswith(prefix))

    def test_legacy_checker_rejects_symlinked_common_ancestors(self):
        for relative in ('harness/common', 'harness/common/checks'):
            with self.subTest(relative=relative), tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
                root = Path(directory)
                self.install(root, ('common', 'project'))
                legacy = root / 'harness/project/checks/ensure_entrypoint_links.py'
                if not legacy.exists():
                    self.skipTest('No legacy shim in a common-only source installation.')
                external = root / 'external'
                checker = external / ('checks/ensure_entrypoint_links.py'
                                      if relative == 'harness/common' else 'ensure_entrypoint_links.py')
                checker.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
                marker = root / 'external-code-executed'
                checker.write_text('from pathlib import Path\nPath(' + repr(str(marker)) + ').touch()\n')
                directory_path = root / relative
                directory_path.rename(directory_path.with_name(directory_path.name + '-original'))
                directory_path.symlink_to(external, target_is_directory=True)
                result = self.run_check(root, str(legacy))
                self.assertFalse(marker.exists(), 'shim must reject symlinked ancestors before execution')
                self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 2, result.stderr)

    def test_required_resource_damage_is_detected(self):
        for mode in MODES:

    def test_project_only_rejected_without_writes(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:

            project = root / 'harness/project'
            if (PACKAGES / 'project').is_dir():

                project.mkdir(parents=True)
            legacy = project / 'checks/ensure_entrypoint_links.py'
            checker = str(legacy) if legacy.exists() else str(PACKAGES / 'common/checks/ensure_entrypoint_links.py')
            result = self.run_check(root, checker)
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 2)
            self.assertIn('common', result.stderr)
            self.assertFalse((root / 'AGENTS.md').exists())
            self.assertFalse((root / 'harness/common').exists())


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()

"""Notification checks use temporary projects and need no configured hooks."""
import contextlib
import importlib.util
import io
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

SCRIPT = Path(__file__).with_name('ensure_entrypoint_links.py')
POLICY = 'технически не заблокировано'
NOTICE = 'Стартовые ссылки повреждены и будут автоматически восстановлены.'
RULES_LINES = ('- [.claude/rules](.claude/rules/)\n'
               'До выполнения задачи прочитай все Markdown-правила из .claude/rules '
               'и его подпапок, кроме README.human.md; соблюдай применимые требования.\n')


class NotificationTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(temporary.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(temporary.name)
        for package in ('common', 'project'):
            directory = self.root / 'harness' / package
            directory.mkdir(parents=True)
            (directory / 'INDEX.md').write_text('# Index\n')
            (directory / 'START.md').touch()
        template = self.root / 'harness/common/base/project-skeleton.json'
        template.parent.mkdir()
        shutil.copyfile(SCRIPT.parent.parent / 'base/project-skeleton.json', template)
        (self.root / 'AGENTS.md').write_text('# Static settings\n\nKeep this setting.\n\n' + ''.join(
            f'- [harness/{p}/{n}](harness/{p}/{n})\n'
            for p in ('common', 'project') for n in ('INDEX.md', 'START.md')) + RULES_LINES)
        (self.root / 'CLAUDE.md').write_text('@AGENTS.md\n')

    def check(self, git_available=True):
        environment = dict(os.environ)
        if not git_available:
            environment['PATH'] = '/nonexistent-for-this-test'
        return subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', str(SCRIPT), str(self.root)],
                              capture_output=True, text=True, env=environment)

    def git(self, *args):
        result = subprocess.run(['git', *args], cwd=self.root, capture_output=True, text=True)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        return result

    def register_fixture(self):
        self.git('init', '-q')
        self.git('config', 'user.name', 'Harness Test')
        self.git('config', 'user.email', 'harness-test@example.invalid')
        self.git('add', 'AGENTS.md', 'CLAUDE.md')
        self.git('commit', '-qm', 'Initial test fixture')

    def test_no_git_binary_or_repository_or_baseline_is_required(self):
        before = (self.root/'AGENTS.md').read_bytes(), (self.root/'CLAUDE.md').read_bytes()
        result = self.check(git_available=False)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        self.assertIn(POLICY, result.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(before, ((self.root/'AGENTS.md').read_bytes(), (self.root/'CLAUDE.md').read_bytes()))

    def test_instruction_change_is_reported_and_preserved_without_blocking(self):
        self.register_fixture()
        agents = self.root/'AGENTS.md'
        changed = agents.read_text().replace('Keep this setting.', 'Changed setting.')
        agents.write_text(changed)
        result = self.check()
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        self.assertIn(POLICY, result.stdout)
        self.assertIn('AGENTS.md', result.stdout)
        self.assertIn('inbox', result.stdout)
        self.assertIn('изменение настроек', result.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(agents.read_text(), changed)

    def test_rules_instruction_added_inside_fence_is_reported_as_a_settings_change(self):
        agents = self.root / 'AGENTS.md'
        original = agents.read_text() + '\n~~~md\n~~~example\n~~~\n'
        agents.write_text(original)
        self.register_fixture()
        instruction = RULES_LINES.splitlines(keepends=True)[1]
        changed = original.replace('~~~example\n', '~~~example\n' + instruction)
        agents.write_text(changed)
        result = self.check()
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        self.assertIn('изменение настроек', result.stdout)
        self.assertNotIn(NOTICE, result.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(agents.read_text(), changed)

    def test_unclosed_historical_fence_does_not_block_repair_of_valid_current_file(self):
        agents = self.root / 'AGENTS.md'
        original = '# Keep user settings\n~~~md\nexample\n'
        agents.write_text(original)
        self.register_fixture()
        current = original + '~~~\n'
        agents.write_text(current)
        result = self.check()
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        self.assertIn('изменение настроек', result.stdout)
        self.assertIn(NOTICE, result.stdout)
        repaired = agents.read_text()
        self.assertTrue(repaired.startswith(current))
        self.assertIn('](harness/common/START.md)', repaired[len(current):])
        before = agents.read_bytes()
        self.assertEqual(self.check().returncode, 0)
        self.assertEqual(agents.read_bytes(), before)

    def test_extra_bridge_text_warns_without_rewriting_or_blocking(self):
        self.register_fixture()
        bridge=self.root/'CLAUDE.md'
        extra='@AGENTS.md\nUser text\n'
        bridge.write_text(extra)
        result=self.check()
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        self.assertIn('CLAUDE.md', result.stdout)
        self.assertIn('inbox', result.stdout)
        self.assertIn(POLICY, result.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(bridge.read_text(), extra)

    def test_repair_is_announced_and_next_run_has_no_damage_message(self):
        agents=self.root/'AGENTS.md'
        line='- [harness/common/START.md](harness/common/START.md)\n'
        agents.write_text(agents.read_text().replace(line,''))
        first=self.check(git_available=False)
        self.assertEqual(first.returncode,0,first.stderr)
        self.assertIn(NOTICE,first.stdout)
        self.assertIn(line,agents.read_text())
        self.assertNotIn(NOTICE,self.check(git_available=False).stdout)

    def test_repair_message_is_visible_before_the_first_write(self):
        agents = self.root/'AGENTS.md'
        line = '- [harness/common/START.md](harness/common/START.md)\n'
        agents.write_text(agents.read_text().replace(line, ''))
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('entrypoint_notifications', SCRIPT)
        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        spec.loader.exec_module(module)
        output = io.StringIO()
        original_write = Path.write_bytes
        def write(path, data, *args, **kwargs):
            self.assertIn(NOTICE, output.getvalue())
            return original_write(path, data, *args, **kwargs)
        from unittest.mock import patch
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(output), patch.object(Path, 'write_bytes', write):
            module.ensure(self.root)
        self.assertEqual(output.getvalue().count(NOTICE), 1)

    def test_rules_repair_is_not_reported_as_a_settings_change(self):
        agents = self.root / 'AGENTS.md'
        agents.write_text(agents.read_text().replace(RULES_LINES, ''))
        self.register_fixture()
        first = self.check()
        self.assertEqual(first.returncode, 0, first.stderr)
        self.assertIn(NOTICE, first.stdout)
        second = self.check()
        self.assertNotIn(NOTICE, second.stdout)
        self.assertNotIn('изменение настроек', second.stdout)

    def test_check_installs_no_hooks_or_configuration_and_does_not_block_commit(self):
        self.register_fixture()
        config=(self.root/'.git/config').read_bytes()
        agents=self.root/'AGENTS.md'
        agents.write_text(agents.read_text()+'\nDirect edit.\n')
        self.assertEqual(self.check().returncode,0)
        self.assertEqual((self.root/'.git/config').read_bytes(),config)
        self.assertFalse((self.root/'.git/hooks/pre-commit').exists())
        self.git('add','AGENTS.md')
        before=self.git('rev-parse','HEAD').stdout
        self.git('commit','-qm','Commit is not mechanically blocked')
        self.assertNotEqual(self.git('rev-parse','HEAD').stdout,before)

    def test_crlf_link_repair_is_not_reported_as_a_settings_change(self):
        agents = self.root / 'AGENTS.md'
        original = agents.read_bytes().replace(b'\n', b'\r\n')
        line = b'- [harness/common/START.md](harness/common/START.md)\r\n'
        original = original.replace(line, b'')
        agents.write_bytes(original)
        self.register_fixture()
        first = self.check()
        self.assertEqual(first.returncode, 0, first.stderr)
        self.assertIn(NOTICE, first.stdout)
        self.assertTrue(agents.read_bytes().startswith(original))
        self.assertIn(line, agents.read_bytes())
        second = self.check()
        self.assertEqual(second.returncode, 0, second.stderr)
        self.assertNotIn(NOTICE, second.stdout)
        self.assertNotIn('изменение настроек', second.stdout)

"""Run with python3 -B <this-file>; uses only temporary projects."""
import json
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

SCRIPT = Path(__file__).with_name('ensure_entrypoint_links.py')


class EntryPointLinksTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.temporary.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.temporary.name)
        for package in ('common', 'project'):
            directory = self.root / 'harness' / package
            directory.mkdir(parents=True)
            (directory / 'INDEX.md').write_text('# Index\n')
            (directory / 'START.md').touch()
        template = SCRIPT.parent.parent / 'base/project-skeleton.json'
        if template.exists():
            destination = self.root / 'harness/common/base/project-skeleton.json'
            destination.parent.mkdir()
            shutil.copyfile(template, destination)

    def run_check(self):
        return subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', str(SCRIPT), str(self.root)],
                              text=True, capture_output=True)

    def test_creates_four_links_and_import_then_preserves_bytes(self):
        result = self.run_check()
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        agents = self.root / 'AGENTS.md'
        claude = self.root / 'CLAUDE.md'
        for package in ('common', 'project'):
            for name in ('INDEX.md', 'START.md'):
                self.assertIn(f'](harness/{package}/{name})', agents.read_text())
        self.assertEqual(claude.read_bytes(), b'@AGENTS.md\n')
        before = (agents.read_bytes(), claude.read_bytes())
        self.assertEqual(self.run_check().returncode, 0)
        self.assertEqual(before, (agents.read_bytes(), claude.read_bytes()))
        for file in self.root.glob('harness/*/START.md'):
            self.assertEqual(file.read_bytes(), b'')

    def test_only_appends_missing_links_preserving_user_text(self):
        prefix = '# User configuration\n\nKeep this exact text.\n[Existing](./harness/common/INDEX.md)\n'
        (self.root / 'AGENTS.md').write_text(prefix)
        self.assertEqual(self.run_check().returncode, 0)
        text = (self.root / 'AGENTS.md').read_text()
        self.assertTrue(text.startswith(prefix))
        self.assertEqual(text.count('harness/common/INDEX.md'), 1)

    def test_link_examples_in_code_do_not_count_as_real_links(self):
        examples = '\n'.join(f'[Example](harness/{p}/{n})'
                             for p in ('common', 'project') for n in ('INDEX.md', 'START.md'))
        (self.root / 'AGENTS.md').write_text(f'```md\n{examples}\n```\n')
        self.assertEqual(self.run_check().returncode, 0)
        text = (self.root / 'AGENTS.md').read_text()
        self.assertEqual(text.count('](harness/common/INDEX.md)'), 2)

    def test_repair_preserves_original_bytes_and_each_files_line_endings(self):
        agents, claude = self.root / 'AGENTS.md', self.root / 'CLAUDE.md'
        for newline in (b'\n', b'\r\n'):
            with self.subTest(newline=newline):
                original = newline.join((b'# User settings', b'Keep exact bytes.', b'', b''))
                bridge = b'User bridge text\r\n'
                agents.write_bytes(original)
                claude.write_bytes(bridge)
                result = self.run_check()
                self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
                repaired = agents.read_bytes()
                self.assertTrue(repaired.startswith(original))
                self.assertIn(b'](harness/common/START.md)' + newline, repaired)
                if newline == b'\r\n':
                    self.assertNotIn(b'\n', repaired.replace(b'\r\n', b''))
                self.assertEqual(claude.read_bytes(), b'@AGENTS.md\r\n' + bridge)
                before = agents.read_bytes(), claude.read_bytes()
                second = self.run_check()
                self.assertEqual(second.returncode, 0, second.stderr)
                self.assertNotIn('будут автоматически восстановлены', second.stdout)
                self.assertEqual((agents.read_bytes(), claude.read_bytes()), before)

    def test_valid_crlf_bridge_is_preserved_without_warning_or_repair(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.run_check().returncode, 0)
        agents, claude = self.root / 'AGENTS.md', self.root / 'CLAUDE.md'
        agents.write_bytes(agents.read_bytes().replace(b'\n', b'\r\n'))
        claude.write_bytes(b'@AGENTS.md\r\n')
        before = agents.read_bytes(), claude.read_bytes()
        result = self.run_check()
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        self.assertNotIn('будут автоматически восстановлены', result.stdout)
        self.assertNotIn('требуется единственная строка', result.stdout)
        self.assertEqual((agents.read_bytes(), claude.read_bytes()), before)

    def test_longer_fence_closers_do_not_turn_examples_into_installed_links(self):
        examples = '\n'.join(f'[Example](harness/{p}/{n})'
                             for p in ('common', 'project') for n in ('INDEX.md', 'START.md'))
        examples += ('\n[Rules](.claude/rules/)\n'
                     'До выполнения задачи прочитай все Markdown-правила из .claude/rules '
                     'и его подпапок, кроме README.human.md; соблюдай применимые требования.')
        agents = self.root / 'AGENTS.md'
        for opener, closer in (('~~~md', '~~~~'), ('```md', '````')):
            with self.subTest(opener=opener):
                prefix = f'# Keep user settings\n{opener}\n{examples}\n{closer}\n'
                agents.write_text(prefix)
                first = self.run_check()
                self.assertEqual(first.returncode, 0, first.stderr)
                text = agents.read_text()
                self.assertTrue(text.startswith(prefix))
                appended = text[len(prefix):]
                for package in ('common', 'project'):
                    for name in ('INDEX.md', 'START.md'):
                        self.assertIn(f'](harness/{package}/{name})', appended)
                self.assertIn('](.claude/rules/)', appended)
                self.assertIn('прочитай все Markdown-правила', appended)
                before = agents.read_bytes()
                second = self.run_check()
                self.assertEqual(second.returncode, 0, second.stderr)
                self.assertEqual(agents.read_bytes(), before)

    def test_unclosed_fence_fails_before_writing_either_entrypoint(self):
        agents, claude = self.root / 'AGENTS.md', self.root / 'CLAUDE.md'
        for name in ('AGENTS.md', 'CLAUDE.md'):
            for opener in ('~~~md', '```md'):
                with self.subTest(name=name, opener=opener):
                    agents.write_text('# Keep user settings\n')
                    claude.write_text('Keep bridge text\n')
                    (self.root / name).write_text(f'# Keep user settings\n{opener}\nexample\n')
                    before = agents.read_bytes(), claude.read_bytes()
                    result = self.run_check()
                    self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 2, result.stderr)
                    self.assertIn('Unclosed Markdown code fence', result.stderr)
                    self.assertEqual((agents.read_bytes(), claude.read_bytes()), before)
                    self.assertFalse((self.root / '.claude').exists())

    def test_damaged_package_is_reported_without_creating_dangling_links(self):
        (self.root / 'harness/project/START.md').unlink()
        result = self.run_check()
        self.assertNotEqual(result.returncode, 0)
        self.assertFalse((self.root / 'AGENTS.md').exists())
        self.assertFalse((self.root / 'CLAUDE.md').exists())

    def test_common_only_creates_neutral_project(self):
        shutil.rmtree(self.root / 'harness/project')
        result = self.run_check()
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        project = self.root / 'harness/project'
        expected = {'base', 'decisions', 'lessons', 'testing', 'rules', 'skills',
                    'checks', 'inbox', 'docs', 'handoffs'}
        self.assertTrue(project.is_dir(), 'common-only must create project')
        self.assertEqual({p.name for p in project.iterdir() if p.is_dir()}, expected)
        for directory in [project, *(project / name for name in expected)]:
            self.assertTrue((directory / 'README.human.md').is_file())
        self.assertFalse((project / 'checks/ensure_entrypoint_links.py').exists())
        self.assertNotIn('EPL', (project / 'INDEX.md').read_text())
        self.assertIn('harness/common/checks/ensure_entrypoint_links.py',
                      (project / 'START.md').read_text())
        self.assertIn('harness/project/START.md', (self.root / 'AGENTS.md').read_text())
        before = {p.relative_to(project): p.stat().st_mtime_ns for p in project.rglob('*')}
        self.assertEqual(self.run_check().returncode, 0)
        self.assertEqual(before, {p.relative_to(project): p.stat().st_mtime_ns for p in project.rglob('*')})

    def test_existing_project_is_not_regenerated_or_exported(self):
        project = self.root / 'harness/project'
        task = project / 'docs/epl-import/notes.md'
        task.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
        task.write_bytes(b'project-specific material\n')
        before = {p.relative_to(project): p.read_bytes() for p in project.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
        self.assertEqual(self.run_check().returncode, 0)
        self.assertEqual(before, {p.relative_to(project): p.read_bytes() for p in project.rglob('*') if p.is_file()})
        self.assertFalse((project / 'base').exists(), 'existing project is not filled with a new skeleton')

    def test_new_template_categories_apply_only_to_new_project(self):
        template = self.root / 'harness/common/base/project-skeleton.json'
        data = json.loads(template.read_text())
        data['categories']['specs'] = {'purpose': 'Shared specifications', 'example': 'api.md describes an agreed API.'}
        template.write_text(json.dumps(data))
        self.assertEqual(self.run_check().returncode, 0)
        self.assertFalse((self.root / 'harness/project/specs').exists())
        shutil.rmtree(self.root / 'harness/project')
        result = self.run_check()
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        self.assertTrue((self.root / 'harness/project/specs/README.human.md').is_file())

    def test_project_only_is_rejected_before_writes(self):
        shutil.rmtree(self.root / 'harness/common')
        result = self.run_check()
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 2)
        self.assertIn('common', result.stderr)
        self.assertFalse((self.root / 'AGENTS.md').exists())

import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

PACKAGES = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
MODES = [('common',), ('common', 'project')]


class PortabilityTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def install(self, root, mode):
        shutil.copytree(PACKAGES / 'common', root / 'harness/common',
                        ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns('inbox', '__pycache__'))
        if 'project' in mode:
            project = root / 'harness/project'
            if (PACKAGES / 'project').is_dir():
                shutil.copytree(PACKAGES / 'project', project)
            else:
                project.mkdir()
                (project / 'INDEX.md').write_text('# Existing project\n')
                (project / 'START.md').write_text('# Existing startup\n')
            material = project / 'docs/local-task/notes.md'
            material.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            material.write_bytes(b'Existing project material\n')

    def run_check(self, root, script='harness/common/checks/ensure_entrypoint_links.py'):
        return subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', script], cwd=root,
                              env=dict(os.environ, PATH='/no-git-in-this-test'),
                              capture_output=True, text=True)

    def test_startup_command_runs_in_each_clean_mode_without_git(self):
        for mode in MODES:
            with self.subTest(mode=mode), tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
                root = Path(directory)
                self.install(root, mode)
                project = root / 'harness/project'
                before = {p.relative_to(project): p.read_bytes() for p in project.rglob('*')
                          if p.is_file() and p.name != 'README.human.md'}
                first = self.run_check(root)
                self.assertEqual(first.returncode, 0, first.stderr)
                if 'project' in mode:
                    self.assertEqual(before, {p.relative_to(project): p.read_bytes()
                                     for p in project.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and p.name != 'README.human.md'})
                else:
                    self.assertTrue((project / 'base/README.human.md').is_file())
                    self.assertFalse((project / 'docs/local-task').exists())
                text = (root / 'AGENTS.md').read_text()
                self.assertIn('](.claude/rules/)', text)
                self.assertIn('harness/project/START.md', text)
                command = re.search(r'(?m)^python3(?: -B)? (harness/[^\s]+\.py)$', text)
                self.assertIsNotNone(command)
                self.assertEqual(command.group(1), 'harness/common/checks/ensure_entrypoint_links.py')
                before_inputs = (root / 'AGENTS.md').read_bytes(), (root / 'CLAUDE.md').read_bytes()
                second = self.run_check(root, command.group(1))
                self.assertEqual(second.returncode, 0, second.stderr)
                self.assertNotIn('будут автоматически восстановлены', second.stdout)
                self.assertEqual(before_inputs, ((root / 'AGENTS.md').read_bytes(), (root / 'CLAUDE.md').read_bytes()))
                self.assertFalse((root / '.git').exists())

    def test_existing_settings_and_startup_command_are_never_rewritten(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            self.install(root, ('common', 'project'))
            legacy = root / 'harness/project/checks/ensure_entrypoint_links.py'
            script = legacy.relative_to(root).as_posix() if legacy.exists() else 'harness/common/checks/ensure_entrypoint_links.py'
            prefix = '# Existing settings\n\npython3 ' + script + '\nKeep this setting.\n'
            (root / 'AGENTS.md').write_text(prefix)
            result = self.run_check(root, script)
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
            self.assertTrue((root / 'AGENTS.md').read_text().startswith(prefix))

    def test_legacy_checker_rejects_symlinked_common_ancestors(self):
        for relative in ('harness/common', 'harness/common/checks'):
            with self.subTest(relative=relative), tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
                root = Path(directory)
                self.install(root, ('common', 'project'))
                legacy = root / 'harness/project/checks/ensure_entrypoint_links.py'
                if not legacy.exists():
                    self.skipTest('No legacy shim in a common-only source installation.')
                external = root / 'external'
                checker = external / ('checks/ensure_entrypoint_links.py'
                                      if relative == 'harness/common' else 'ensure_entrypoint_links.py')
                checker.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
                marker = root / 'external-code-executed'
                checker.write_text('from pathlib import Path\nPath(' + repr(str(marker)) + ').touch()\n')
                directory_path = root / relative
                directory_path.rename(directory_path.with_name(directory_path.name + '-original'))
                directory_path.symlink_to(external, target_is_directory=True)
                result = self.run_check(root, str(legacy))
                self.assertFalse(marker.exists(), 'shim must reject symlinked ancestors before execution')
                self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 2, result.stderr)
                self.assertFalse((root / 'AGENTS.md').exists())

    def test_required_resource_damage_is_detected(self):
        for mode in MODES:
            with self.subTest(mode=mode), tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
                root = Path(directory)
                self.install(root, mode)
                (root / 'harness/common/START.md').unlink()
                result = self.run_check(root)
                self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 2)
                self.assertIn('START.md', result.stderr)
                self.assertFalse((root / 'AGENTS.md').exists())

    def test_project_only_rejected_without_writes(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            project = root / 'harness/project'
            if (PACKAGES / 'project').is_dir():
                shutil.copytree(PACKAGES / 'project', project)
            else:
                project.mkdir(parents=True)
            legacy = project / 'checks/ensure_entrypoint_links.py'
            checker = str(legacy) if legacy.exists() else str(PACKAGES / 'common/checks/ensure_entrypoint_links.py')
            result = self.run_check(root, checker)
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 2)
            self.assertIn('common', result.stderr)
            self.assertFalse((root / 'AGENTS.md').exists())
            self.assertFalse((root / 'harness/common').exists())


if __name__ == '__main__':

"""Notification checks use temporary projects and need no configured hooks."""
import contextlib
import importlib.util
import io
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

SCRIPT = Path(__file__).with_name('ensure_entrypoint_links.py')
POLICY = 'технически не заблокировано'
NOTICE = 'Стартовые ссылки повреждены и будут автоматически восстановлены.'
RULES_LINES = ('- [.claude/rules](.claude/rules/)\n'
               'До выполнения задачи прочитай все Markdown-правила из .claude/rules '
               'и его подпапок, кроме README.human.md; соблюдай применимые требования.\n')


class NotificationTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(temporary.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(temporary.name)
        for package in ('common', 'project'):
            directory = self.root / 'harness' / package
            directory.mkdir(parents=True)
            (directory / 'INDEX.md').write_text('# Index\n')
            (directory / 'START.md').touch()
        template = self.root / 'harness/common/base/project-skeleton.json'
        template.parent.mkdir()
        shutil.copyfile(SCRIPT.parent.parent / 'base/project-skeleton.json', template)
        (self.root / 'AGENTS.md').write_text('# Static settings\n\nKeep this setting.\n\n' + ''.join(
            f'- [harness/{p}/{n}](harness/{p}/{n})\n'
            for p in ('common', 'project') for n in ('INDEX.md', 'START.md')) + RULES_LINES)
        (self.root / 'CLAUDE.md').write_text('@AGENTS.md\n')

    def check(self, git_available=True):
        environment = dict(os.environ)
        if not git_available:
            environment['PATH'] = '/nonexistent-for-this-test'
        return subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', str(SCRIPT), str(self.root)],
                              capture_output=True, text=True, env=environment)

    def git(self, *args):
        result = subprocess.run(['git', *args], cwd=self.root, capture_output=True, text=True)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        return result

    def register_fixture(self):
        self.git('init', '-q')
        self.git('config', 'user.name', 'Harness Test')
        self.git('config', 'user.email', 'harness-test@example.invalid')
        self.git('add', 'AGENTS.md', 'CLAUDE.md')
        self.git('commit', '-qm', 'Initial test fixture')

    def test_no_git_binary_or_repository_or_baseline_is_required(self):
        before = (self.root/'AGENTS.md').read_bytes(), (self.root/'CLAUDE.md').read_bytes()
        result = self.check(git_available=False)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        self.assertIn(POLICY, result.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(before, ((self.root/'AGENTS.md').read_bytes(), (self.root/'CLAUDE.md').read_bytes()))

    def test_instruction_change_is_reported_and_preserved_without_blocking(self):
        self.register_fixture()
        agents = self.root/'AGENTS.md'
        changed = agents.read_text().replace('Keep this setting.', 'Changed setting.')
        agents.write_text(changed)
        result = self.check()
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        self.assertIn(POLICY, result.stdout)
        self.assertIn('AGENTS.md', result.stdout)
        self.assertIn('inbox', result.stdout)
        self.assertIn('изменение настроек', result.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(agents.read_text(), changed)

    def test_rules_instruction_added_inside_fence_is_reported_as_a_settings_change(self):
        agents = self.root / 'AGENTS.md'
        original = agents.read_text() + '\n~~~md\n~~~example\n~~~\n'
        agents.write_text(original)
        self.register_fixture()
        instruction = RULES_LINES.splitlines(keepends=True)[1]
        changed = original.replace('~~~example\n', '~~~example\n' + instruction)
        agents.write_text(changed)
        result = self.check()
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        self.assertIn('изменение настроек', result.stdout)
        self.assertNotIn(NOTICE, result.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(agents.read_text(), changed)

    def test_unclosed_historical_fence_does_not_block_repair_of_valid_current_file(self):
        agents = self.root / 'AGENTS.md'
        original = '# Keep user settings\n~~~md\nexample\n'
        agents.write_text(original)
        self.register_fixture()
        current = original + '~~~\n'
        agents.write_text(current)
        result = self.check()
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        self.assertIn('изменение настроек', result.stdout)
        self.assertIn(NOTICE, result.stdout)
        repaired = agents.read_text()
        self.assertTrue(repaired.startswith(current))
        self.assertIn('](harness/common/START.md)', repaired[len(current):])
        before = agents.read_bytes()
        self.assertEqual(self.check().returncode, 0)
        self.assertEqual(agents.read_bytes(), before)

    def test_extra_bridge_text_warns_without_rewriting_or_blocking(self):
        self.register_fixture()
        bridge=self.root/'CLAUDE.md'
        extra='@AGENTS.md\nUser text\n'
        bridge.write_text(extra)
        result=self.check()
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        self.assertIn('CLAUDE.md', result.stdout)
        self.assertIn('inbox', result.stdout)
        self.assertIn(POLICY, result.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(bridge.read_text(), extra)

    def test_repair_is_announced_and_next_run_has_no_damage_message(self):
        agents=self.root/'AGENTS.md'
        line='- [harness/common/START.md](harness/common/START.md)\n'
        agents.write_text(agents.read_text().replace(line,''))
        first=self.check(git_available=False)
        self.assertEqual(first.returncode,0,first.stderr)
        self.assertIn(NOTICE,first.stdout)
        self.assertIn(line,agents.read_text())
        self.assertNotIn(NOTICE,self.check(git_available=False).stdout)

    def test_repair_message_is_visible_before_the_first_write(self):
        agents = self.root/'AGENTS.md'
        line = '- [harness/common/START.md](harness/common/START.md)\n'
        agents.write_text(agents.read_text().replace(line, ''))
        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('entrypoint_notifications', SCRIPT)
        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        spec.loader.exec_module(module)
        output = io.StringIO()
        original_write = Path.write_bytes
        def write(path, data, *args, **kwargs):
            self.assertIn(NOTICE, output.getvalue())
            return original_write(path, data, *args, **kwargs)
        from unittest.mock import patch
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(output), patch.object(Path, 'write_bytes', write):
            module.ensure(self.root)
        self.assertEqual(output.getvalue().count(NOTICE), 1)

    def test_rules_repair_is_not_reported_as_a_settings_change(self):
        agents = self.root / 'AGENTS.md'
        agents.write_text(agents.read_text().replace(RULES_LINES, ''))
        self.register_fixture()
        first = self.check()
        self.assertEqual(first.returncode, 0, first.stderr)
        self.assertIn(NOTICE, first.stdout)
        second = self.check()
        self.assertNotIn(NOTICE, second.stdout)
        self.assertNotIn('изменение настроек', second.stdout)

    def test_check_installs_no_hooks_or_configuration_and_does_not_block_commit(self):
        self.register_fixture()
        config=(self.root/'.git/config').read_bytes()
        agents=self.root/'AGENTS.md'
        agents.write_text(agents.read_text()+'\nDirect edit.\n')
        self.assertEqual(self.check().returncode,0)
        self.assertEqual((self.root/'.git/config').read_bytes(),config)
        self.assertFalse((self.root/'.git/hooks/pre-commit').exists())
        self.git('add','AGENTS.md')
        before=self.git('rev-parse','HEAD').stdout
        self.git('commit','-qm','Commit is not mechanically blocked')
        self.assertNotEqual(self.git('rev-parse','HEAD').stdout,before)

    def test_crlf_link_repair_is_not_reported_as_a_settings_change(self):
        agents = self.root / 'AGENTS.md'
        original = agents.read_bytes().replace(b'\n', b'\r\n')
        line = b'- [harness/common/START.md](harness/common/START.md)\r\n'
        original = original.replace(line, b'')
        agents.write_bytes(original)
        self.register_fixture()
        first = self.check()
        self.assertEqual(first.returncode, 0, first.stderr)
        self.assertIn(NOTICE, first.stdout)
        self.assertTrue(agents.read_bytes().startswith(original))
        self.assertIn(line, agents.read_bytes())
        second = self.check()
        self.assertEqual(second.returncode, 0, second.stderr)
        self.assertNotIn(NOTICE, second.stdout)
        self.assertNotIn('изменение настроек', second.stdout)
